name: Transports
description: Registers continent transports (ships, zeppelins): gameobject templates of type MO_TRANSPORT (15) listed here are spawned globally and travel along their TaxiPath; period is the time of one full path loop in milliseconds.

fields.name: Entry
fields.help: Gameobject template entry of type MO_TRANSPORT (15).

fields.name: Name
fields.help: Internal descriptive name of the transport.

fields.name: Period
fields.help: Time of one full path loop in milliseconds; must match the client-computed path period or movement desyncs.
